title: Hospital Ward Bed-Fall Clinical Demonstration Scenario
description: Authentic multi-stage hospital surveillance video depicting an elderly patient resting, waking to sit at bed edge, experiencing loss of balance, and collapsing onto the floor with post-impact immobility.

groundTruthTimeline.label: Normal Resting in Bed
groundTruthTimeline.clinicalNotes: Patient Anita Sharma supine in bed within mattress perimeter; zero downward velocity; stable vitals.

groundTruthTimeline.label: Bed-Edge Sitting
groundTruthTimeline.clinicalNotes: Patient sits up and pivots legs to bed perimeter; spine upright (~18°); controlled muscular transfer. Must NOT trigger false alarm.

groundTruthTimeline.label: Suspected Descent
groundTruthTimeline.clinicalNotes: Patient slips forward off mattress edge; vertical velocity spikes downward (>1.0 m/s); body center of mass descends.

groundTruthTimeline.label: Floor Contact / Impact Collapse
groundTruthTimeline.clinicalNotes: Impact transition with floor boundary; torso orientation collapses to horizontal (56-60°); kinetic energy collapses.

groundTruthTimeline.label: Recovery Observation Window
groundTruthTimeline.clinicalNotes: System monitors whether patient self-rights or remains immobile; no postural recovery observed.

groundTruthTimeline.label: Resident Verification & Acute High-Risk
groundTruthTimeline.clinicalNotes: Unrecovered floor immobility exceeds threshold; resident verification check-in modal displayed on screen; escalation ladder armed.

groundTruthTimeline.label: Video Concluded / Standby
groundTruthTimeline.clinicalNotes: Video playback concludes; camera transitions cleanly to idle monitoring rather than infinite emergency loop.

evaluationNotes: This metadata is strictly for offline validation and benchmark reporting. Runtime inference pipeline must independently derive physical kinematics from frame data without consulting this file.
